shortDescription: Load, check, or export schemas in Infrahub

options.name: action
options.description: The schema action to perform. C(load) loads schemas into Infrahub. C(check) validates schemas without applying them. C(export) exports existing schemas from Infrahub.

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: Endpoint of the Infrahub API, optional env=INFRAHUB_ADDRESS

options.name: branch
options.description: Branch in which the request is made

options.name: namespaces
options.description: List of namespace names to filter the export. Only used with C(action=export).

options.name: schema_files
options.description: List of YAML file paths containing schema definitions. Files are read on the Ansible controller. For C(load) and C(check), at least one of C(schemas) or C(schema_files) must be provided.

options.name: schemas
options.description: List of inline schema definitions (nodes and generics). For C(load) and C(check), at least one of C(schemas) or C(schema_files) must be provided.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout for Infrahub requests in seconds

options.name: token
options.description: The API token created through Infrahub, optional env=INFRAHUB_API_TOKEN

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not to validate SSL of the Infrahub instance

options.name: wait_until_converged
options.description: Wait for schema to be synchronized across all workers. Only used with C(action=load).
